newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Illinois Tool EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Illinois Tool EPS view up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it had increased its 1997 earnings-per-share estimate on Illinois Tool Works Inc to $3.63 from $3.45 and established a 1998 estimate of $5.15.

-- For the increase in the 1997 estimate, EVEREN analyst Quint Nufer cited expectations of higher operating margins. He said in a report that it appeared the record margin levels posted in the 1996 fourth quarter are sustainable.
-- EVEREN increased its six-month price target on the stock to $97 from $91, and its 18-month target to $108 from $101.
-- Illinois Tool was trading up one point at 80-3/4.
